name: Mangroves by longtail

seo.title: Koh Lanta Mangrove Tour by Longtail | Secret Travel & Tour
seo.metaDescription: Half a day by longtail in the Thung Yee Peng mangrove on Koh Lanta, with lunch, monkeys and birds, plus Old Town or a fishing park. From 1,000 THB.

h1: The Thung Yee Peng mangrove by longtail
lead: Half a day in the mangrove on the east side of Koh Lanta, by longtail through the narrow canals, with lunch. Add Lanta Old Town and a viewpoint, or a fishing park.

facts.label: Where
facts.value: Thung Yee Peng, east coast of Koh Lanta

facts.label: Village entrance fee
facts.value: 40 THB per adult, 20 THB per child from 4 to 11, not included

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove boat trip with lunch. A longtail around the mangrove forest, then lunch, fruit and a soft drink at the mangrove restaurant. 09:30 to 12:30 or 14:00 to 17:00.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove, Old Town and viewpoint. A longtail through the narrow canals, with monkeys and birds, then lunch and a visit of Lanta Old Town. 09:30 to 12:30 or 14:00 to 17:00.

steps.label: Half day
steps.text: Mangrove and fishing park. The mangrove by kayak or longtail, lunch at the mangrove restaurant, then the fishing park. 09:30 to 12:30 or 14:00 to 17:00.

beforeYouBook.children: Children from 4 to 11 have a child rate.

faq.a: The half day with lunch is the simplest. Pick Old Town and the viewpoint to see more of the island, or the fishing park if you are travelling with children.

legacyText.title: Koh Lanta Mangrove Tour | Secret Travel & Tour
intro: Thung Yee Peng is a village on the east coast of Koh Lanta with a protected mangrove behind it. The channels are calm. You see monkeys, birds and fiddler crabs on the mud at low tide.

Three ways to go. A longtail runs through the main channels. A private wooden raft, poled slowly, leaves from Thung Yee Peng pier for a sunrise, a fishing morning or a dinner at sunset. A kayak gets you into the narrow channels.
legacyText.cardDescription: Through the mangroves by longtail, gondola or kayak.
goodToKnow: The raft is private, for your group only. Children from 3 to 9 have a child rate.
The kayak can be combined with an hour of ATV in the forest, two hours in all.
Bring mosquito repellent for sunrise and sunset.
legacyText.priceNote: Prices in Thai baht. On the longtail and kayak trips the village entrance fee, 40 THB per person, is not included.
legacyText.caption: Thung Yee Peng
